hook: A health measurement is more useful when you can see it over time.
caption: One number is a moment. A series is a picture. 67 beats per minute, fingertip, quality fair, 80.3 milliseconds HRV RMSSD: one reading on its own. The baseline builds after four morning readings, and every morning adds one more point. No diagnosis, just your data over time. Discover HealthGraph. #HealthGraph #PulseCheck #HeartRate #HRV #SelfTracking #HealthData #MeasureOverTime #DigitalHealth

lines.text: A health measurement is more useful when you can see it over time.
lines.beat: a fingertip on the sensor; the single number 67 BPM appears, then fades out

lines.text: One number is a moment. A series is a picture.
lines.beat: one big number alone on the dark background, then it becomes a dot on a small time axis

lines.text: Like this: 67 beats per minute, fingertip, quality fair.
lines.beat: real pulse-measurement screen: 67 BPM, FINGERTIP, Quality Fair, 60 seconds

lines.text: The same screen shows one more value: 80.3 milliseconds, HRV RMSSD.
lines.beat: focus pulls to the second value block: 80.3 MS, HRV RMSSD

lines.text: One reading tells you little on its own.
lines.beat: the number dims again; emphasis shifts to the series, not the single point

lines.text: The screen says: the baseline builds after four morning readings.
lines.beat: the line Baseline builds after 4 morning readings is highlighted on the pulse-measurement screen

lines.text: Every morning adds one more point to the same line.
lines.beat: a reproduced time-axis chart: one new dot lands per morning, generic labels only

lines.text: Same data. Now it has direction.
lines.beat: the dots connect into a calm dotted line across the chart

lines.text: No diagnosis. Just your data over time.
lines.beat: camera holds on the finished line; no labels other than the real values
end card on warm charcoal, the dotted line motif behind the CTA
